title: The fiscal limits of efficient trade
abstract: arXiv:2610.34460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sustaining efficient trade under private information requires external subsidies. Although a designer cannot avoid deficits on average, they can control exposure. We characterize efficient and truthful mechanisms that minimize the worst-case deficit in markets with many buyers and sellers, under interim participation. This problem is dual to maximizing expected trade surplus under correlation ambiguity, with constraints on submarkets with one agent removed. In bilateral trade, the best deficit ceiling is the competitive surplus in a benchmark continuum market, achieved by a "competitive pivot mechanism". In larger markets, optimal mechanisms are characterized in terms of worst-case residual welfare contributions, but solutions exhibit a complex combinatorial structure. translated_abstract: 在私人信息下维持有效交易需要外部补贴。尽管机制设计者无法在平均意义上避免赤字，但可以控制风险敞口。我们在临时参与条件下，刻画了在存在众多买家和卖家的市场中使最坏情况赤字最小化的有效且真实的机制。该问题与在相关性模糊下最大化预期交易剩余的问题互为对偶，其约束条件施加于移除某一代理人后的子市场。在双边贸易中，最佳赤字上限等于一个基准连续统市场中的竞争剩余，并可通过“竞争枢轴机制”实现。在更大的市场中，最优机制通过最坏情况下的剩余福利贡献来刻画，但其解呈现出复杂的组合结构。我们在自然的参与收费限制下获得了显式保证，并证明了最佳赤字超额随市场规模的扩大而衰减。我们的对偶刻画……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 本文刻画了私人信息下使最坏情况赤字最小化的有效真实交易机制，并通过对偶性证明：在双边贸易中，最佳赤字上限等于基准连续统市场的竞争剩余，可由“竞争枢轴机制”实现，且赤字超额随市场变厚而衰减。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes efficient and truthful mechanisms that minimize worst-case deficits in trade under private information, showing via duality that in bilateral trade the optimal deficit ceiling equals the competitive surplus of a benchmark continuum market—achieved by a "competitive pivot mechanism"—and that the deficit excess decays as the market thickens.
